Item.Name: T_ACCEPT_MIN
Item.Hint: Enter minimum acceptable value for parameter.

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText: :GLOBAL.original_value := :test_parms.t_accept_min;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if nvl(:GLOBAL.original_value,'XNULLX') =
 nvl(:test_parms.t_accept_min,'XNULLX')
 then
 return;
 end if;
 if :test_parms.t_accept_min is not null
 then
 if :test_parms.datatype in ('NUMBER','DATE')
 then
 if ltrim(:test_parms.t_accept_min,'-1234567890.') is not null
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,'-') not in (0,1)
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 :test_parms.accept_min := :test_parms.t_accept_min;
 elsif :test_parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 if ltrim(:test_parms.t_accept_min,'-1234567890:') is not null
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,':')
 not in (0,NVL(length(:test_parms.t_accept_min), 0) - 2)
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,'-') not in (0,1)
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 if instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,':') = 0
 then
 :test_parms.accept_min := :test_parms.t_accept_min;
 else
 if substr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,
 instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,':')+1,1) > '5'
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 :test_parms.accept_min := 
 to_number(substr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,
 1, instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,':')-1)) * 60 
 +to_number(substr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,
 instr(:test_parms.t_accept_min,':')+1));
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 :test_parms.accept_min := null;
 end if;
exception
 when value_error
 then
 if :test_parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 show_error('3141');
 else
 show_error('1707');
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Item.Name: T_ACCEPT_MAX
Item.Hint: Enter maximum acceptable value for parameter.

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 minmax_error exception;
begin
 if nvl(:GLOBAL.original_value,'XNULLX') =
 nvl(:test_parms.t_accept_max,'XNULLX')
 then
 return;
 end if;
 if :test_parms.t_accept_max is not null
 then
 if :test_parms.datatype in ('NUMBER','DATE')
 then
 if ltrim(:test_parms.t_accept_max,'-1234567890.') is not null
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,'-') not in (0,1)
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 :test_parms.accept_max := :test_parms.t_accept_max;
 if :test_parms.accept_max < :test_parms.accept_min then
 raise minmax_error; 
 end if;
 elsif :test_parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 if ltrim(:test_parms.t_accept_max,'-1234567890:') is not null
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,':')
 not in (0,NVL(length(:test_parms.t_accept_max), 0) - 2)
 or instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,'-') not in (0,1)
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 if instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,':') = 0
 then
 :test_parms.accept_max := :test_parms.t_accept_max;
 else
 if substr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,
 instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,':')+1,1) > '5'
 then
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 :test_parms.accept_max := 
 to_number(substr(:test_parms.t_accept_max, 1, instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,':')-1)) *60 
 +to_number(substr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,
 instr(:test_parms.t_accept_max,':')+1));
 IF :test_parms.accept_max < :test_parms.accept_min THEN
 raise minmax_error;
 END IF; 
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 :test_parms.accept_max := null;
 end if;
exception
 when minmax_error then
 show_error('3123'); 
 when value_error
 then
 if :test_parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 show_error('3141');
 else
 show_error('1707');
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_hrs number;
 temp_mins number;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_time2 date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 
begin
 select description, datatype, related_code
 into :test_parms.description, :test_parms.datatype,
 :test_parms.related_code
 from valid_test_parms
 where parm_code = :test_parms.parm_code;
 
 if :test_parms.datatype != 'DEVICE'
 then
 if :test_parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 if :test_parms.accept_min is not null
 then
 temp_hrs := trunc(:test_parms.accept_min/60,0);
 temp_mins := mod(:test_parms.accept_min,60);
 :test_parms.t_accept_min := ltrim(rtrim(to_char(temp_hrs)) || ':'||
 lpad(ltrim(to_char(temp_mins),' '),2,'0')); 
 end if;
 if :test_parms.accept_max is not null
 then
 temp_hrs := trunc(:test_parms.accept_max/60,0);
 temp_mins := mod(:test_parms.accept_max,60);
 :test_parms.t_accept_max := ltrim(rtrim(to_char(temp_hrs)) || ':'||
 lpad(ltrim(to_char(temp_mins),' '),2,'0')); 
 end if;
 else
 :test_parms.t_accept_min := :test_parms.accept_min;
 :test_parms.t_accept_max := :test_parms.accept_max;
 end if;
 end if;

 --MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if :test_parms.eff_date is not null then
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :test_parms.eff_date_temp := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, :test_parms.eff_date);
 ELSE
 :test_parms.eff_date_temp := :test_parms.eff_date;
 END IF; 
 end if;
 --MS 


 --MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if :test_parms.term_date is not null then
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :test_parms.term_date_temp := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, :test_parms.term_date);
 ELSE
 :test_parms.term_date_temp := :test_parms.term_date;
 END IF; 
 end if;
 --MS

 -- MLT 4 SCR 655143 (Compares db values with ctrl blk value and sets record status to changed to fire pre-update trigger);
 if NVL(globalvar.gv_db_tech1,'N') <> NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.s_tech1,'N') OR NVL(globalvar.gv_db_tech2,'N') <> NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.s_tech2,'N') then
 Set_Record_Changed_Status;
 end if;
 --
exception
 when others then null;
end;

begin
 :test_parms.test_id := :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 :test_parms.parm_type := :ctrl_blk_1.parm_type;
 :test_parms.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :test_parms.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 
 -- MLT-4 -- SCR 655143
 assign_tech1_tech2;
 -- 
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/11/2011. IM 5479
 if :test_parms.term_date_temp is not null then
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then

 :test_parms.term_date := v_gmt_time;
 else

 end if;
 
 v_gmt_time := null;

ProgramUnit.Name: RESEQUENCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure resequence (old_seq in number, new_seq in number) is
 temp_rec varchar2(3);
 temp_sequence number;
begin
 temp_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_test_parms v, test_parms t
 where t.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and v.datatype != 'DEVICE'
 and (( v.related_code = :test_parms.parm_code
 and v.parm_code = t.parm_code
 and t.sequence <= new_seq)
 or ( v.parm_code = :test_parms.parm_code
 and v.related_code = t.parm_code
 and t.sequence >= new_seq));
 show_error('3111');
 check_package_failure;
exception
when no_data_found then
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record != temp_rec
 then
 if (new_seq is not null and :test_parms.sequence >= new_seq) and
 (old_seq is null or :test_parms.sequence <= old_seq)
 then
 :test_parms.sequence := :test_parms.sequence + 1;
 elsif (old_seq is not null and :test_parms.sequence >= old_seq) and
 (new_seq is null or :test_parms.sequence <= new_seq)
 then
 :test_parms.sequence := :test_parms.sequence - 1;
 end if;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 temp_sequence := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 go_record(temp_rec);
 if :test_parms.sequence > temp_sequence
 then
 :test_parms.sequence := temp_sequence;
 end if;
when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
